paragraphs.text: The Little Vampire 3D (Dutch: De Kleine Vampier 3D) also known as The Little Vampire, is a 2017 3D animated vampire film directed by and Karsten Kiilerich, loosely based on the 2000 live-action film of the same name and based on the characters of the children's book series of the same name by German writer Angela Sommer-Bodenburg.
